title: Custom LiquidityLauncher strategy + HookemonIssuance wiring + CREATE2 hook mining
goal: Write and test a custom launch strategy (the stock InstantLaunchStrategy is unusable), wire it to the existing fail-closed HookemonIssuance guard so HKMN is actually created through the launchpad, and mine the hook's CREATE2 address against the finalized permission mask.
steps: Write a custom LiquidityLauncher strategy contract (not native-ETH, not fixed-1e9-supply) and its tests, against a fork of the vendored liquidity-launcher submodule

Wire CustomLaunchStrategy as the concrete provider adapter HookemonIssuance.sol's own doc comment calls for: call prepareOfficialIssuance with a plan matching the fixed 90%/10% split (WHOLE_HKMN_SUPPLY=420_690_000_000, otherAllocation=0) already enforced in HookemonIssuance._validatePlan, using decision D10's answer (or, if D10 is still open, a clearly-labeled placeholder per design.md section 3.8) for remainderRepresentation and the LBP curve parameters

Perform the real mint/allocation through LiquidityLauncher/UERC20Factory, then call verifyIssuance with the real observed balances and a 2-element TransferRecord trace proving the market and remainder legs landed exactly as planned

Add HookemonIssuanceIntegration.t.sol: a regression test proving readTokenState().status reaches OBSERVATION_VERIFIED_PROVIDER_BINDING_PENDING only after a real (forked) launch call through CustomLaunchStrategy, never from a hand-constructed observation not actually produced by the launcher
Do not begin CREATE2 mining until WP-05's hookData relaxation is finalized and WP-25's Universal Router probe has resolved which router address is live
Mine the hook address against the finalized permission mask using the RPC-verified-live router address
acceptance: Strategy compiles and passes unit tests against a forked launcher
A forked launch call through CustomLaunchStrategy actually mints/allocates HKMN and HookemonIssuance.verifyIssuance accepts the resulting observation
A hand-constructed (not launcher-produced) observation is rejected by verifyIssuance's existing trace/allocation checks
Mined hook address matches the finalized permission mask
Mining used the router address confirmed live by WP-25's probe, not an unverified pin
notes: Hard-blocked on WP-25 completing first, not merely sequenced after — mining before the router address resolves risks a wasted or wrong mine. Also gated on owner decision D10 (remainderRepresentation custody + LBP curve parameters) for the final, non-placeholder version — see design.md section 3.8/11 D10 for what may proceed against a documented placeholder in the meantime.
